daily_kpi: MET before this additional study — multiple distinct real-data backtests were completed earlier on 2026-11-25
data_scope: FRED SP500, VIXCLS and DEXJPUS daily; aligned price coverage 2016-11-28 to 2026-11-24; 412 non-overlapping six-session-spaced origins; validation 2019–2021; test 2022 onward
disposition: INCONCLUSIVE — evidence is mixed, statistically uncertain or insufficient under the frozen decision rule

event_construction.signal_rule: signal-date SP500/VIX close; latest DEXJPUS observation strictly before signal date; target begins next S&P 500 session

limitations: DEXJPUS is a daily noon buying reference rate, not an executable FX price or intraday carry-position series.
A one-sided yen-appreciation shock is only a proxy for potential carry unwind; it does not observe investor leverage, positioning, funding costs or forced liquidation.
SP500 is a cash price index, not an executable futures series or total-return index.
FRED current-vintage observations were used; historical release vintages were not reconstructed.
The latest DEXJPUS observation strictly before each signal date is used; same-date values are excluded.
Forecasting only: no causal claim, transaction-cost model, tradable strategy or live deployment conclusion.
No raw source data are committed; only hashes, retrieval metadata and aggregate metrics are retained.

methodology.fx_feature: max(0, -100 * log(DEXJPUS_latest / DEXJPUS_five_observations_earlier)); DEXJPUS is JPY per USD, so a falling quote is yen appreciation
methodology.target: log1p(next-five-session S&P 500 realized volatility in percent)
methodology.training_rule: training target_end_date must be strictly earlier than current signal_date
